action: Draws a Slice curve across a smooth head blob to divide it into planes/polygroups.
why: Separate the face front from the side as a polygroup/plane break.
reader_equivalent: Face Sets by Line/Lasso, or Edit Mode knife

action: Positions a separate ear piece on the side of the chibi head with the Gizmo (rotate Y).
tool: Gizmo 3D (Rotar Y) on a DynaMesh subtool
why: Make ears as separate parts and place them before merging.
reader_equivalent: Separate ear object; G/R/S or the transform gizmo; later Boolean Union + voxel remesh

action: Chibi face with very large round eyes engraved as concentric grooves (lid, iris, pupil rings), small nose bump and ear.
why: Chibi proportion: eyes take a large part of the face height.
reader_equivalent: Crease (subtract) circles; Draw for lid rims

action: Starts a low-poly cylinder with coloured polygroups (cap vs side) for a body/limb part.
why: Clean low-poly base for a tube shape.
reader_equivalent: Mesh > Cylinder with face sets per cap

action: Front of the head: open O mouth, big ringed eyes, small horn, hair as long flat strips with grooves; inserts a small cylinder into the mouth.
why: Build the mouth/teeth from a primitive part.
reader_equivalent: Add cylinder object, place in mouth, Boolean/Join

action: Uses the gizmo to deform a flat oval piece on top of the head.
why: Shape an accessory/base piece by deforming a primitive.
reader_equivalent: Lattice or Simple Deform on a primitive

action: Blocks out the hand from a rounded box palm plus separate rectangular finger boxes in polygroups, fanned with the gizmo.
why: Fingers start as simple boxes so length and spread are easy to set.
reader_equivalent: Cubes for palm/fingers, arranged then voxel remeshed; or a Skin-modifier hand

action: Poses a finger of the sculpted hand with a Transpose line, rotating around a knuckle with the rest masked.
why: Pose the fingers after the shape is done.
reader_equivalent: Mask + Pose brush or Rotate with pivot at the knuckle

action: Refines one long S-curved hair lock with grooves running along its length.
why: Long hair is made of separate S-shaped lock pieces with internal grooves.
reader_equivalent: Curve-to-mesh or a Snake Hook tube; Crease along its length

action: Shows the assembled character: big witch hat with a bent tip, long wavy hair, robe with rope, open hands.
Builds a twisted rope from a low-poly helix and a woven basket with a rope handle.
tool: Low-poly spiral primitive + Gizmo; woven pattern (IMM/curve brush inferred)
why: Repetitive accessories are made from primitives, not hand-sculpted.
reader_equivalent: Screw modifier / curve with twist; Array along curve for weave

action: Sculpts a thick rolled sleeve cuff with a crisp inner fold edge.
why: Cloth edges are thick and crisp in this style.
reader_equivalent: Solidify cloth + Crease/Pinch on the fold

action: Shows a broom head of many long bristle grooves fanning out.
Final render of the painted figure: pumpkin hat band, basket, broom, boots, with 'Full Video in our Chanell' text.
